description: Get details for a GitHub pull request (title, description, author, branches, change stats) via the workspace GitHub connection. Read it before writing a checklist for the change, then report back with comment_on_pr.

owner.description: GitHub repository owner (user or organisation), e.g. "vercel".

pr_number.description: Pull request number, e.g. 42 for owner/repo#42.

repo.description: GitHub repository name without the owner, e.g. "next.js".

workspace_id.description: Workspace UUID, from list_workspaces. Every read and write is scoped to it.

name: get_pull_request

author.description: GitHub login of the PR author.

body.description: PR description in Markdown, null when empty.

state.description: open or closed (merged PRs are closed).

title: Get pull request
